# Build: gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-15T11:53:25.282Z
> Where is the gate and rules plugin, open it on my screen. Yeah.

## What to build
Continue build "Gate & rules plugin in the console" (gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console) — Phase 2, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-15 11:53):
"Where is the gate and rules plugin, open it on my screen. Yeah."
This phase downgrades Fable → Opus: fine, no approval needed (it is recorded when you tick its first step).
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console
Steps in this phase (18 left, ~2.7 h):
[ ] s6 (~7 min) Scaffold the plugin apps/console-web/plugins/gate/: plugin.json (builtWith, description, lifecycle.dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs, uninstall.mjs, README.md with the lifecycle marker, and register it in the plugin catalog.
[ ] s7 (~10 min) Write the gate store adapter apps/console-web/plugins/gate/gate-store.mjs: read and write the rule set and history through the current orchestrator and lander code (push-banner land settings, merge-queue state) behind one interface, so a later molly backend replaces only this file.
[ ] s8 (~10 min) Write the lander adapter apps/console-web/plugins/gate/lander.mjs with ONE mode switch 'Merge queue on/off' (Brett 06:59): ON = PRs go through the stacked merge queue (land.mjs queue add) and the one-at-a-time auto-lander is off; OFF (the default) = merge queue off and the auto-lander lands each finished build one at a time (merge main first, fix clashes, then land). Flipping it takes effect at once and is logged in History. Also: status (running/paused/idle, current mode), last N runs, waiting PRs with the gate-rules evaluate reasons, land now (follows the current mode), pause and resume. The default rule set in s3 must not force 'merge-queue only'.
[ ] s9 (~7 min) Write the History log: append-only JSONL in the plugin dataDir for rule changes (who, when, before/after) and lander actions, plus read with filters (kind, since, pr).
[ ] s10 (~10 min) Add the FastAPI routes in apps/console-web/plugins/gate/server/: GET rules, PUT rules/<id>, POST rules/<id>/toggle, POST rules/reset, GET lander, GET lander/waiting, GET lander/runs, POST lander/land-now, pause, resume, GET history. Destructive presses need confirm.
[ ] s11 (~8 min) Add the CLI apps/console-web/plugins/gate/gate.mjs (rules list|get|set|on|off|reset, lander status|waiting|runs|land-now|pause|resume, history) and wire `axf gate …` in framework/cli/axf.mjs through the plugin-commands path.
[ ] s12 (~10 min) Expose the gate.* and lander.* MCP tools from the console MCP server (through plugin-commands, matching GATE.md names) and register them for axHub routing. Add the voice/AmberX console actions gate.open, gate.rule, lander.land-now, lander.pause, lander.resume.
[ ] s13 (~9 min) Build the plugin view shell GateView.tsx: a framework TabGroup (tab-group asset, settings id gate.tabs) with Rules, Auto-lander and History tabs, SkinScope root, remember last tab. Register console-control targets view:gate and tab:gate.tabs=<tab> plus console_show deep links.
[ ] s14 (~10 min) Build the Rules tab: a DataGrid of rules that follows the skin's 1-or-2-row grid setting, each row with a Switch (on/off), severity chip and a settings popover using framework fields; register row:<rule>/setting targets. Tokens only.
[ ] s15 (~8 min) Add the Rules tab toolbar (role=toolbar, aria-label gate.rules): Reset to defaults (confirm), Check a PR (opens gate.check_pr result dialog). Wire every control to the same REST routes the CLI and MCP use.
[ ] s16 (~10 min) Build the Auto-lander tab: status card (running/paused, since, current stack), waiting grid (PR, build, which rule holds it and why) on the 1-or-2-row grid setting, last runs grid, toolbar with Land now and Pause/Resume; register control targets for every button and row.
[ ] s17 (~8 min) Build the History tab: grid of rule changes and lander actions (1-or-2-row setting), filter chips by kind, a row detail showing before/after; register targets.
[ ] s18 (~8 min) Add the plugin's settings sub-tab under Settings → Plugins → Gate (refresh interval, history size, default tab) with the level toolbar, and settings keys readable/writable through REST, MCP, CLI and voice.
[ ] s19 (~8 min) Add the console nav entry (Builds → Gate & rules), the help page, glossary descriptions, notify.json for 'lander paused' and 'PR held by gate' alerts, and a systems-check health item when the lander is stuck.
[ ] s20 (~10 min) Write unit tests: gate-rules core against fixtures, gate-store and lander adapters against a temp land/queue dir, history append/filter, REST route tests, CLI vs MCP parity test (same inputs → same outputs).
[ ] s21 (~10 min) Run the CI checks (check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-chrome-assets, check-console-control, glossary catalog --check, plugin-lifecycle check gate --after-uninstall, tracker --check) and fix findings.
[ ] s22 (~10 min) Re-bake the console, run vite preview, take desktop and phone shots of the three tabs, and submit to UI Review with 3 options (grid density / card layout / compact) as assets in plugins/gate/assets/.
[ ] s23 (~10 min) Log the plugin in Shipped features, update catalog status and tracker, then write the report _claude/builds/reports/gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console.md (what was built, API parity table: deep link, state, actions, settings across REST/MCP/CLI/voice; molly handover), add the THREADS row, push the branch, link it with builds-live.mjs and open the PR for the merge queue.
Read first: apps/console-web/plugins/gate/plugin.json, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/install.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/uninstall.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/README.md, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/gate-store.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/lander.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/push-banner/land/, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/history.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/server/routes.py, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/gate.mjs, framework/cli/axf.mjs, apps/console-web/server/mcp_server.py, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/commands.json, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/GateView.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/index.ts, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/RulesTab.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/CheckPrDialog.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/LanderTab.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/HistoryTab.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/web/GateSettings.tsx, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/settings.json, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/help.md, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/notify.json, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/health.py, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/test.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/server/test_routes.py, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/, apps/console-web/plugins/gate/assets/, apps/console-web/src/axf/, _claude/builds/reports/gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console.md, _claude/THREADS.md, framework/catalog/status.json, tracker.json
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Opus phase. Work through every step of the phase in this one session: they are checkpoints, not separate tasks. As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note gate-rules-plugin-in-the-console "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
